test_cases.test_case: Login with valid credentials
preconditions: User is on the Login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Username field blank and submit
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Password field blank and submit
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with invalid credentials
steps: 1. Enter <invalid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with locked out user
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with empty Username field
steps: 2. Enter a valid password in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username is required.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with empty Password field
steps: 1. Enter a valid username in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Password is required.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with invalid credentials
steps: 1. Enter a username that is not in the accepted usernames list
2. Enter the shared password 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with locked out user
steps: 2. Enter the shared password 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

test_cases.test_case: Enter long string in Username field
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) in the Username field
2. Enter the shared password 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Login attempt is blocked; an error message is displayed indicating the username is invalid.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in Username field
steps: 1. Enter special characters (e.g., @#$%^&) in the Username field
2. Enter the shared password 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Login attempt is blocked; an error message is displayed indicating the username is invalid.

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading/trailing whitespace in Username field
steps: 1. Enter '   standard_user   ' in the Username field
2. Enter the shared password 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; the username is saved as 'standard_user'.

test_cases.test_case: View Product Detail
steps: 1. Click on a product name or image
test_cases.expected_result: opens Product Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart when not in cart
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Add to cart' button changes to 'Remove'; the cart badge count updates accordingly.

test_cases.test_case: Remove from cart when in cart
test_cases.expected_result: removes item from cart

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name (A–Z)
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in ascending order by name.

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name (Z–A)
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in descending order by name.

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price (low–high)
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in ascending order by price.

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price (high–low)
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in descending order by price.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add an item to cart when it is already in the cart
preconditions: Item is already in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on the 'Add to cart' button for an item already in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Status remains 'In Cart'; no item is added again; 'Add to cart' button is not visible

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item from cart when it is not in the cart
preconditions: Item is not in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on the 'Remove' button for an item not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Status remains 'Not In Cart'; no item is removed; 'Remove' button is not visible

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view product detail without selecting a product
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on the 'View Product Detail' action without selecting a product
test_cases.expected_result: No Product Detail page opens; error message indicates a product must be selected

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add to cart when the item is already in the cart
preconditions: Item is already in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on the 'Add to cart' button for an item already in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; item is not added again; error shown on 'Add to cart' button

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove from cart when the item is not in the cart
preconditions: Item is not in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on the 'Remove' button for an item not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; item is not removed; error shown on 'Remove' button

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly add and remove item from cart
test_cases.expected_result: 'Remove' action succeeds; item is removed from cart and 'Add to cart' button is displayed again.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly remove item from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Second 'Remove' action is blocked; item remains in cart and 'Remove' button is still displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Sort dropdown with special characters
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted alphabetically from A to Z.

test_cases.test_case: Sort dropdown with long text
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted by price from low to high.

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
preconditions: Product is currently not in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product added to cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product removed from cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Go to shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove product when not in cart
steps: 1. Ensure product is not in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; no product is removed from cart; Remove button is not available

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add product to cart when already in cart
steps: 2. Click on Add to cart button
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; no product is added to cart; Add to cart button is not available

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate back to products while on Product Detail page
steps: 1. Click on Back to products button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates back to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to go to shopping cart from Product Detail page
steps: 1. Click on Go to Shopping Cart button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions from Not_In_Cart to In_Cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product removed from cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions from In_Cart to Not_In_Cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product added to cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products after adding to cart
preconditions: Product has been added to cart
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to shopping cart from product detail
preconditions: Product has been added to cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Continue Shopping from Shopping Cart
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: Checkout from Shopping Cart
test_cases.expected_result: begins checkout process

test_cases.test_case: Remove item from Shopping Cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' on an item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Item removed from cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to continue shopping without any items in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User remains on the Shopping Cart page; no items are available to continue shopping

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to checkout with no items in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User remains on the Shopping Cart page; cannot proceed to checkout with no items

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item that is not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; item not found in cart

test_cases.test_case: Rapid navigation after clicking Continue Shopping
preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory without pre-filled cart items

test_cases.test_case: Rapid navigation after clicking Checkout
preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the checkout process without pre-filled cart items

test_cases.test_case: Remove all items from cart
preconditions: User has multiple items in the cart
steps: 1. Click Remove on the first item
2. Click Remove on the second item
3. Click Remove on the third item
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; no items remain in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Submit valid checkout information
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid zip/postal code> in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: User proceeds to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout process
test_cases.expected_result: User returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Leave the First Name field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill Last_Name and Zip_Postal_Code with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First_Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Last Name field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill First_Name and Zip_Postal_Code with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Last_Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill First_Name and Last_Name with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Zip_Postal_Code field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
steps: 1. Leave the First_Name, Last_Name, and Zip_Postal_Code fields blank
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First_Name, Last_Name, and Zip_Postal_Code fields indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in First Name
steps: 1. Enter '   John   ' in the First Name field
2. Enter 'Doe' in the Last Name field
3. Enter '12345' in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in the overview step is 'John'.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in Last Name
steps: 1. Enter 'John' in the First Name field
2. Enter '@Doe!' in the Last Name field
3. Enter '12345' in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with Last Name as '@Doe!'.

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in Zip/Postal Code
steps: 1. Enter 'John' in the First Name field
2. Enter 'Doe' in the Last Name field
3. Enter '12345678901234567890' in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with Zip/Postal Code as '12345678901234567890'.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with empty First Name
steps: 2. Enter 'Doe' in the Last Name field
3. Enter '12345' in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Error: First Name is required.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with empty Last Name
steps: 1. Enter 'John' in the First Name field
3. Enter '12345' in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Last Name is required.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with empty Zip/Postal Code
steps: 1. Enter 'John' in the First Name field
2. Enter 'Doe' in the Last Name field
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Postal Code is required.

test_cases.test_case: Finish the order successfully
test_cases.expected_result: completes the order and navigates to the confirmation page

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout successfully
test_cases.expected_result: exits checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish the order without any payment information
steps: 1. Leave the Payment Information section blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown on Payment Information field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to cancel the checkout without any prior action
test_cases.expected_result: User is exited from checkout; no changes made to the order

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive submission of the Finish button
preconditions: User is on the overview step of the checkout process
steps: 1. Click the Finish button to complete the order
2. Immediately click the Finish button again
test_cases.expected_result: The first submission completes the order; the second submission is blocked with a visible message indicating the order is already being processed.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive submission of the Cancel button
preconditions: User is on the overview step of the checkout process
steps: 1. Click the Cancel button to exit checkout
2. Immediately click the Cancel button again
test_cases.expected_result: The first click exits the checkout; the second click is ignored with no additional action taken.

test_cases.test_case: Display success message and return to product inventory
test_cases.expected_result: The page displays 'Thank you for your order!'

test_cases.test_case: Return to Product Inventory and clear the cart
preconditions: User is on the Confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory and clears the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to click 'Back Home' without a successful order
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout - Confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked; the user remains on the Confirmation page and the cart is not cleared.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after redirect
preconditions: User has successfully completed the checkout process
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory; the cart is cleared and no duplicate order is created.

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
test_cases.expected_result: ends the session and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to logout while not logged in
preconditions: user must be logged in is NOT met
steps: 1. Ensure the user is not logged in
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is not performed; user remains on the current page

test_cases.test_case: Rapid logout attempts
steps: 2. Immediately click the Logout button again
test_cases.expected_result: First logout action succeeds and redirects to the login page; second logout action is ignored as the session has ended.

test_cases.test_case: Logout while not logged in
steps: 1. Attempt to click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: Logout button is disabled or not displayed, preventing logout action.

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State functionality
test_cases.expected_result: clears the cart and resets in-app state

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset app state without any preconditions
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
test_cases.expected_result: The app state does not reset; no changes occur to the cart or in-app state
